clue.text: Be serious about trivial matter

parts.note: mean can describe something petty or of little worth
business is a matter or affair, as in 'a strange business'

explanation.surface: Someone is told to take a small matter seriously.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in earnest about getting something done is an idiom for showing determination.

clue.text: Military officer, within, earshot

indicators.note: something within earshot is heard, so the officer's title is taken by its sound

parts.note: a marshal is a high-ranking officer

explanation.surface: A soldier of rank stands close enough to overhear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'within earshot' says the officer's title MARSHAL is heard, giving a word that sounds the same; the commas are newspaper scanning noise.
explanation.definitionFit: Martial means relating to war or soldiers, a synonym of military.

clue.text: Calm fears after losing a partner

indicators.note: losing signals that the letter named next is dropped from the word for calming

parts.note: to allay fears is to calm them

explanation.surface: Someone's nerves are soothed once a companion leaves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing a' removes one A from ALLAY; 'partner' looks like part of the surface story but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An ally is a supporter joined with you in a cause, so a partner.

clue.text: Faulty equipment put in by European company

indicators.note: put in signals that the equipment word is placed inside the pieces that follow

parts.note: something faulty is bad
a rig is a set of equipment, as on an oil rig

explanation.surface: A European firm is blamed for installing broken machinery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'company' reads as the European firm of the surface, but it is the definition, a military unit like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A brigade is a body of troops, and company is likewise a military unit; more loosely any organised group.

clue.text: Keep fit enthusiast on board ?

parts.note: read first as someone who exercises with a rope, then as the person in charge of a vessel

explanation.surface: A fitness fan has joined the crew.
explanation.walkthrough: A rope-jumper is one who skips, but the word is also the captain of a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a person jumping rope for exercise and the captain of a boat.

clue.text: Vote against new opposition leader is impossibility

parts.note: a no is a vote against

indicators.note: leader signals the first letter of the word after it

explanation.surface: A rejected motion in parliament shows the opposition chief cannot win.
explanation.definitionFit: A no-no is something not allowed or not possible, an informal term for a thing ruled out.

clue.text: Find out writer's daughter Ayr is causing delay

parts.note: to sus (or suss) is to work out or discover
a pen is a writer; the 's is read as 'has' joining the next piece

explanation.surface: A father discovers his child is the reason for a hold-up.
explanation.definitionFit: To suspend something is to postpone it, so a verb for putting off.

clue.text: Housing allowance

explanation.surface: A benefit paid towards somewhere to live.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is lodging or a place to stay; the other is a concession or compromise made to suit someone.

clue.text: Rhyme without reason ?

parts.note: plays on the phrase 'rhyme or reason', describing poetry that is deliberately absurd

explanation.surface: Poetry that makes no sense.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a genre of comic poems full of absurd words, as by Edward Lear.

clue.text: Italian composer's heart sick on reflection

parts.note: the core of something is its heart

indicators.note: a reflection reverses what it shows, so the word for sick is read backwards

parts.note: ill means sick

explanation.surface: An Italian musician feels unwell when thinking things over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on reflection' turns ILL into LLI; the 's of composer's stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Arcangelo Corelli was a Baroque violinist and composer from Italy.

clue.text: Dramatist's so nice but torn by love

indicators.note: something torn is pulled apart, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: love is nil in tennis scoring, written as O

explanation.surface: A playwright is pleasant but divided by romance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'torn' rearranges SO NICE into IONESC, then O follows; the 's of Dramatist's stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Eugene Ionesco was a Romanian-French playwright of the Theatre of the Absurd.

clue.text: Short notice for one who has just gone

definitions.text: Short notice for one who has just gone

parts.words: Short notice for one who has just gone
parts.note: suggests a brief warning to someone who has stepped out, but means an abbreviated death announcement

explanation.surface: A quick message left for someone who has only just left.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the shortened form of obituary, a published notice of someone's death.

clue.text: Plug a popular US holiday resort

parts.note: to tamp is to pack down or plug, as tobacco in a pipe

explanation.surface: An advertisement promoting a favourite American vacation spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Tampa is a city on the Gulf coast of Florida, popular with visitors.

clue.text: Areas of growth in S. Central England

explanation.surface: Where plants thrive in the southern middle of England.
explanation.walkthrough: Beds is the short form of Bedfordshire, an English county north of London.
explanation.definitionFit: Garden plots for plants are one sense; the other is the abbreviated name of a county in that region.

clue.text: Chopping top off garden herb causes a rash

indicators.note: the top of a down entry is its first letter, which is chopped away

parts.note: chives are a garden herb of the onion family

explanation.surface: Cutting a herb plant brings someone out in spots.
explanation.definitionFit: Hives is the everyday name for urticaria, an itchy skin eruption.

clue.text: Make a hole in sock

explanation.surface: Damaging a piece of hosiery.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is to pierce or perforate; the other is to hit with the fist, as sock means in slang.

clue.text: Uneasy feeling that Amelia's in trouble

indicators.note: letters in trouble are thrown into disorder, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone senses that a woman named Amelia is facing difficulties.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in trouble' rearranges the seven letters of AMELIAS; here the 's does give a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Malaise is a vague sense of discomfort or unease.

clue.text: Attack globally ?

parts.note: read as an assault made all around the world, but meaning to turn on someone verbally

explanation.surface: A worldwide offensive.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn on someone suddenly with criticism is a phrasal verb built from the word for circular.

clue.text: Somehow minds about English saint's obscurity

indicators.note: about here means surrounding, so the shuffled letters go around the next piece
somehow suggests an arrangement reached in some unknown way, so these letters are shuffled

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for saint

explanation.surface: Someone's mind turns to an English saint shrouded in mystery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Somehow' rearranges MINDS into DIMNS; 'about' puts that around E, giving DIMNES, and S follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Obscurity is a lack of light or clarity, which is what dimness also means.

clue.text: Dream of becoming ideally suited

indicators.note: becoming signals the letters turn into something else, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone fantasises about the perfect match.
explanation.definitionFit: If two things are made for each other they are perfectly matched.

clue.text: Give as a result of strain

explanation.surface: Something yields under pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: Give is the slack or elasticity in a material; the other sense is the lengthening a pull causes.

clue.text: Craft from the Middle East carrying first-rate stuff

indicators.note: carrying means holding inside, so the region's abbreviation goes around the next pieces

parts.note: ME is the abbreviation for the Middle East
A, as in A1, means first-rate
to cram is to stuff

explanation.surface: A handicraft imported from the Middle East full of fine material.
explanation.definitionFit: Macramé is a craft of knotting cord into decorative patterns.

clue.text: Scheduled in advance to royal personage

indicators.note: in signals that the word for scheduled is placed inside the word for advance

parts.note: to march is to advance
an event that is on is scheduled to happen

explanation.surface: A timetable set beforehand for a member of the royal family.
explanation.definitionFit: A monarch is a king or queen, a sovereign ruler.

clue.text: He doesn't believe a thief initially over armed robbery

indicators.note: initially signals that only the first letter of the next word is used

parts.note: a heist is a robbery, usually an armed one

explanation.surface: A sceptic doubts that a thief was behind a raid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' is a link in a down clue: A and T sit above HEIST.
explanation.definitionFit: An atheist is a person who rejects belief in any god.

clue.text: Sizeable spruce

explanation.surface: A large evergreen tree.
explanation.definitionFit: A tidy sum is a considerable one; spruce also means neat and orderly.

clue.text: Sounds like stamp money

indicators.note: sounds like says the word for stamp is taken by how it is pronounced

parts.note: to frank a letter is to stamp it to show postage is paid

explanation.surface: A remark about the cost of postage.
explanation.definitionFit: The franc was the currency of France and is still that of Switzerland.

clue.text: Objective old you

parts.note: read as an unbiased elderly person, but meaning the archaic second-person pronoun in the object case

explanation.surface: Calling someone long in the tooth fair-minded.
explanation.definitionFit: Thou was the archaic subject form of the pronoun, and this is its object form, as in 'I love thee'.

clue.text: Right to go into treasure origin

indicators.note: to go into means to be placed inside, so the letter for right enters the word for treasure

parts.note: a gem is a treasure, a precious thing

explanation.surface: A treasure-hunter's claim on where something started.
explanation.definitionFit: A germ is the seed or starting point from which something develops, as in the germ of an idea.

clue.text: Girl in them made quite stir

indicators.note: in tells us the girl's name lies inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A young woman caused quite a commotion among them.
explanation.walkthrough: The name runs across the join of thEM MAde.
explanation.definitionFit: Emma is a girl's name.

clue.text: Not in time to catch eccentric

explanation.surface: An oddball who can never keep the rhythm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to catch' is just a link here.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is falling between the beats, out of rhythm; the other means unconventional or odd.

clue.text: Rest of checks involving academic

indicators.note: involving here means enclosing, so the word for checks goes around the degree

parts.note: reins check or restrain, as a rider checks a horse
an MA, Master of Arts, is an academic degree

explanation.surface: The remaining exams are overseen by a scholar.
explanation.definitionFit: The remainder of something left over is what is still there after the rest is gone.

clue.text: Mother is upset with father -truly

indicators.note: upset means knocked over or disturbed, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A mother is distressed by the father, and means it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is upset' rearranges the twelve letters of MOTHER and FATHER together.
explanation.definitionFit: Speaking sincerely, with real feeling, is what the phrase means.
